propositions: The idempotency test patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings to binding_lifecycle which resolves its own _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the oracle's blast radius narrowed and would not catch regressions where clear_absent stamps updated_at unconditionally.
The unit-tier contract is already pinned via test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, containing the coverage gap to that tier.

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window pass due to its call-site guards (persist check, out-of-window key requirement), so seeding an unconditional-stamp mutation cannot drive the integration test red regardless of patch coverage.
